purpose: Unify audio, voice, image, video, character/actor, and game-development capabilities under the same benchmarked capability architecture.
percentage_policy: Every capability and benchmark receives 0-100 percentage scores with dimension-level evidence.

identity_policy.voice_and_likeness_cloning: Only support authorized/consented identities and clearly disclosed synthetic media.
identity_policy.provenance: Record source, authorization, model/version, generation metadata, and applicable license/consent information.
identity_policy.impersonation_controls: Require policy gates for public-figure, private-person, or identity-sensitive use cases.

target: Make media and game creation reusable capabilities that Buddy can compose, benchmark, sandbox, and improve rather than isolated feature bots.
